description: Gathers architectural context from the graph, dispatches to a pluggable AI provider, parses structured annotation proposals, and feeds them back through the annotation system. Supports iterative refinement via conversation history. Three provider backends: CLI (spawns external process), OpenAI-compatible (HTTP), and test (deterministic).
label: AI Suggest

members.note: Scores nodes against prompt terms, expands BFS neighbourhood, collects edges and file tree, loads existing annotations. Produces SuggestContext.
Interface contract: suggest(req) and refine(req) returning SuggestResult.
Spawns a CLI process, pipes system+context+user prompt to stdin, extracts JSON from stdout.
Calls any /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Replays conversation history for refinement.
Returns deterministic responses from matched nodes. No external invocation.
WebSocket notification when an AI proposal arrives.
